evidence: You can walk the Round the Mountain Track in either direction; here we describe it going clockwise.
The track begins along Ngauruhoe Place, 100 m below Whakapapa Visitor Centre.
From here the track undulates for a number of easy climbs and descents before joining the well formed Silica Rapids Track, for the last 45 min to Whakapapa Village.

doubts: The start is given as F2, one of two road-end features both named 'where Taranaki Falls Track meets NGAURUHOE TERRACE' (F2, F3, about 100 m apart, likely the Lower and Upper Taranaki Falls Track starts); the text calls the street Ngauruhoe Place, not Terrace. The loop actually finishes on the Silica Rapids Track at a different village entrance (just above Whakapapa Holiday Park), but end is set to the start ref because the loop returns to Whakapapa Village. The two Taranaki Falls options (Lower and Upper) are alternatives at the start and not separate ways. F6 (Waitonga Falls carpark) and F7 (Wanganui Corner) are assigned by their order up Ohakune Mountain Road (11-12 km and 15 km); the main way walks 3 km up the road between them. The junction before Whakapapaiti Hut offers a finish at Scoria Flat on Bruce Road instead of Whakapapa Village; not recorded as a separate way. W2/W3 are the page's example of doing part of the track over 2 or 3 days; their exact end point on Ohakune Mountain Road and their via are not stated, so the via lists only the huts on that side and end ref is null. T28 'Waihohonu Hut' is assumed to be the new hut, not the historic one. Old Blyth Track is an alternative exit to the 7 km point of Ohakune Mountain Road, not part of the described way.
